title: Failed-Visit Trip Charges on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services charges a failed-visit trip charge when an installation or warranty visit could not proceed because the customer was absent or the site was not ready. The charge is made for the most recent such visit recorded on the contract.

## The charge line

- The failed-visit trip charge posts as one trip charge line on the contract, referencing the visit record it arises from, at the amount the failed-visit trip charge rule fixes.
- The visit record is the line on which the installer recorded the visit and its outcome (customer absent, or site not ready).
- Once posted, the trip charge appears on the contract's statement of charges and the contract's balance due rises by the charge.

## Invocation

The charge is posted with the agent-side tool `post_trip_charge_9239fb96`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call adds one trip charge line, dated the day it is posted and tied to the visit record.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract the charge is posted on, as returned by the installation contract lookup for the customer | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `visit_charge_id` | the reference number of the recorded visit line the charge arises from, as returned by the installation contract line lookup for that contract | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `charge_amount` | the trip charge, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the new charge line), `install_contract_id` (the contract charged), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `fee_type` (always `trip_charge`), `original_charge_id` (the visit line the charge refers to), `amount` (the charge posted, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the charge, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the charge is on the contract.

## Basis questions answered

**Which visit does the charge refer to when the customer side caused more than one failed visit?** The most recent visit recorded on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready.
